groups.operation: Read supported compressed ancillary metadata after IDAT through png_read_end.
groups.condition: A PNG contains supported compressed ancillary metadata after IDAT and is read to IEND.
groups.capability: Reach a supported handler that calls png_decompress_chunk.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the same general post-IDAT metadata operation and unresolved path to decompression.

groups.operation: Read compressed zTXt after IDAT through png_read_end.
groups.condition: A PNG contains supported zTXt after IDAT and is read to IEND.
groups.capability: Dispatch to the zTXt handler and its png_decompress_chunk call.
groups.consequence: The zTXt metadata is not decompressed.
groups.equivalence_reason: This names a specific zTXt path; the broader metadata candidates do not establish the same triggering chunk.

groups.operation: Continue png_read_row after png_read_update_info and a subsequent png_start_read_image call.
groups.condition: png_read_update_info has initialized row state before the harness calls png_start_read_image.
groups.capability: Handle the duplicate initialization report from png_app_error according to PNG_FLAG_APP_ERRORS_WARN while allowing row decoding.
groups.consequence: The duplicate-call report may stop decoding accepted PNG rows.
groups.equivalence_reason: All five describe the same duplicate row initialization sequence and its possible effect on row reading.

groups.operation: Decode Adam7 rows through png_read_row after configuring png_set_interlace_handling.
groups.condition: The harness calls png_set_interlace_handling after png_read_update_info may have initialized row state.
groups.capability: Maintain interlace transformation, pass, and row state consistent with the sequential row loop.
groups.consequence: Pass or row counts may be inconsistent during Adam7 decoding.
groups.equivalence_reason: All four concern the same late interlace configuration and its possible effect on Adam7 row state.
